tools.name: get_hiring_index
tools.description: VLSI Semiconductor Hiring Index: a weekly index of semiconductor industry hiring activity in Korea (job posting based). Use week='latest' (default) or a week key like '2026-W42'.

tools.name: get_news_feed
tools.description: VLSI Korea semiconductor news intelligence feed for a date ('latest' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Returns a 'not yet generated' status when no feed exists for the snapshot.

tools.name: get_predictions
tools.description: VLSI Korea's public prediction track record (semiconductor market calls with outcomes). Filter by status: 'pending', 'hit', 'miss', or 'all' (default).

tools.name: search_qna
tools.description: Search VLSI Korea's semiconductor Q&A knowledge base (e.g. STA, HBM, packaging, EDA). Keyword matching over title+question+answer; returns top 5 with excerpts.

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: Look up semiconductor terms in the VLSI multilingual glossary (400+ terms). Partial match on the English term; returns the translation in the requested language (en, ko, ja, zh_tw, es, pt, id, vi).

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search VLSI Korea's published semiconductor articles (2,600+ posts) by keyword over title, excerpt and tags. Title matches rank highest. Optionally filter by language (ko, en, ja, zh-tw, zh, es, pt, id, vi). Returns title, URL, date, excerpt, language and tags.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Get the newest published VLSI Korea semiconductor articles, newest first. Optionally filter by language (ko, en, ja, zh-tw, zh, es, pt, id, vi). This is the daily semiconductor knowledge briefing feed — call it to see what VLSI Korea published most recently.

tools.name: get_daily_briefing
tools.description: Get VLSI Korea's daily semiconductor briefing: the most recent Daily Silicon issue (all language editions) and the most recent Market Bulletin issue, grouped with title, URL, excerpt and date. Start here for today's semiconductor knowledge briefing.

tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Get an end-of-day quote for a semiconductor stock covered by VLSI Korea market data (~113 tickers). Match by slug, ticker (e.g. '000660' or '000660.KS'), or company name (e.g. 'SK hynix'). Daily change % is computed from the last two daily closes. Delayed EOD data, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: List semiconductor stocks whose absolute daily change (computed from the last two daily closes) is at or above a threshold percent, sorted by absolute change descending. Direction: 'all' (default), 'up', or 'down'. Delayed EOD data, not investment advice.
